response.text: Invoices 802 and 803 share a vendor and amount. I'll look at them, and check whether the closed-period postings were made after the close.

arguments.sql: select i.*, h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."MEMO", h."SRC_REF" from "APINVH" i join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID">=798 order by i."INV_ID"

select h."JRNL_NO",h."PRD_ID",h."POST_DT",h."SRC_CD",h."MEMO",h."SRC_REF",p."STAT_CD",p."CLOSE_DT" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where h."JRNL_NO">=2400 or h."JRNL_NO" in (select max("JRNL_NO") from "GLJRNH") order by 1 limit 20
